hero.description: I specialize in building scalable, modern web applications from robust backend architectures to pixel-perfect, interactive frontend experiences. Welcome to my showcase project:

skills.title: Core Expertise.
skills.frontend_desc: Crafting dynamic, responsive interfaces with a focus on polished aesthetics and fluid animations.
skills.backend_desc: Designing robust REST APIs, real-time sockets, and efficient database schemas.
skills.devops_desc: Streamlining deployments and maintaining code quality through containerization.

projects.title: The System in Action.
projects.subtitle: Built from scratch, this system handles everything from point-of-sale transactions to kitchen order synchronization.
projects.pos_sync_desc: A lightning-fast Point of Sale interface that communicates instantly with the kitchen display using WebSockets. When an order is placed, chefs know immediately.
projects.payment_desc: Seamless checkout experience with dynamic QR code generation for Vietnamese banking apps (VietQR), coupled with webhook listeners for automated payment verification.

footer.description: Experience the full Coffee Shop Management System. Log in as an admin or staff member to see the dashboard, POS, and kitchen screens in action.
